lines.zh: : 还要！

lines.en: : More sex! More!
lines.zh: : 还要做爱！还要！

lines.en: Ami's legs expand in size and begin to wrap around my body, tying themselves into a tight knot so that I will never be free again.
lines.zh: Ami 的双腿膨胀变大，开始缠住我的身体，打成一个死结，让我再也逃脱不掉。

lines.en: Unfortunately, she ties the knot too tightly and I suddenly feel the world around me going black.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，她把结打得太紧，我忽然感觉到周围的世界正在变黑。

lines.en: scene black
: Hey, Sensei...before you go...can I tell you a secret?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei……在你走之前……我能告诉你一个秘密吗？

lines.en: : Can't...stay conscious...
lines.zh: : 我……快保持不住意识了……

lines.en: : Don't worry. I won't take long.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我不会花太久的。

lines.en: : I just want you to know that...
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你知道……

lines.en: : Not everything is always as it seems...
lines.zh: : 并不是一切都像看上去的那样……

lines.en: : But you should already know that more than anyone, right?
lines.zh: : 不过这点你该比任何人都清楚，对吧？

lines.en: Paralyzed once more, I’m unable to respond.
lines.zh: 我再次全身瘫软，无法回应。

lines.en: But I'm not sure what I would have said even if I could.
lines.zh: 可就算我能回应，我也不确定自己会说什么。

lines.en: The last bit of light left in my body makes an exit.
lines.zh: 我体内残存的最后一点光，悄然离去。

lines.en: But that's okay, for the light of the sun has replaced it.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为阳光已经取代了它。

lines.en: And all that is left for me to do is wake up in a better place...
lines.zh: 而如今我唯一还能做的，就是在一个更好的地方醒来……

lines.en: $ amiawake = True
jump amiwakesupyeah
label amiwakesupyeah:
: Hey, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei？

lines.en: : Senseiiiii?...
lines.zh: : Senseiiiii？……

lines.en: : Earth to Sensei...
lines.zh: : 呼叫 Sensei……

lines.en: A soft prodding at my cheek brings the world back into sight.
lines.zh: 脸颊上轻轻的戳弄，让世界重新回到了眼前。

lines.en: scene amiwakeup1
: Morning!
lines.zh: : 早上好！

lines.en: : How did you sleep?
lines.zh: : 你睡得怎么样？
: Ami？……

lines.en: I take a moment to regain my senses and wipe away the sleep from my eyes.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间找回神智，揉掉眼里的睡意。

lines.en: : How long have you been here?...
lines.zh: : 你在这儿多久了？……

lines.en: scene amiwakeup3
: I just got here. Why?
lines.zh: : 我刚到。怎么了？

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Is...something wrong?
lines.zh: : 是……有什么不对劲吗？

lines.en: : No, it's nothing. Forget I even said anything.
lines.zh: : 不，没什么。当我没说过。

lines.en: scene amiwakeup2
: Uhh, okay! Whatever you say.
lines.zh: : 呃，好吧！你说什么就是什么。

lines.en: : Hey, were you having a weird dream or something?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你刚才是不是做了什么奇怪的梦？

lines.en: : You were rolling around a lot when I first came into the room.
lines.zh: : 我刚进房间的时候，你翻来覆去滚得可厉害了。

lines.en: : Nope. Everything's totally normal here.
lines.zh: : 没有。这里一切都很正常。

lines.en: scene amiwakeup4
: Well, whatever it was, you better hurry up and get ready.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管是什么，你最好快点准备好。

lines.en: : We need to leave in the next fifteen minutes if we’re going to make it to[school] on time.
lines.zh: : 我们要想在十五分钟内出发、准时赶到[school]的话。

lines.en: : Your breakfast is on the table! I’m going to go do my makeup really quick.
lines.zh: : 你的早餐在桌上！我得赶紧去化个妆。

lines.en: : Okay, got it. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 好，知道了。谢啦。

lines.en: scene amiwakeup5
: {i}No problem.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不客气。{/i}

lines.en: scene amiwakeupgone
Ami exits the room. I hear her door open and close just a few seconds later.
lines.zh: Ami 走出了房间。几秒钟后，我听见她的房门开了又关。

lines.en: : What the fuck was that dream?...
lines.zh: : 那个梦到底是什么鬼？……

lines.en: scene black
